sections.skill: Define appropriate quantities and units for a model

questions.skill: Define appropriate quantities and units for a model
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 9 as a second forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.prompt: You want to estimate how many times a heart beats in one day. Which two quantities do you need, and what are their units?
questions.prompt_markup:
You want to estimate how many times a heart beats in one day.
Which two quantities do you need, and what are their units?
questions.correct_answer: The heart rate (beats per minute) and the number of minutes in a day (minutes per day).

questions.skill: Define appropriate quantities and units for a model
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 9 as a second forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.prompt: You want to model the cost of gas for a car trip to another city. Name three quantities you would define, with their units.
questions.prompt_markup:
You want to model the cost of gas for a car trip to another city.
Name three quantities you would define, with their units.
questions.correct_answer: The distance (miles), the car's fuel efficiency (miles per gallon), and the gas price (dollars per gallon).
questions.grading_note: Any three relevant quantities with sensible units are correct; for example, kilometers and liters may be used instead.
